messages:
maria: Quick poll — open mic tonight: YAML ballads, SemVer stand-up, or compiler impressions? :microphone: :yum:
devin: YAML ballads. I have a heroic indent solo ready. :notes: :laughing:
sam: SemVer stand-up. I'll do a bit called 'Major Breakup with My API (2.0.0)'. :rolling_on_the_floor_laughing:
maria: @sam make sure the breakup joke is backwards compatible with earlier punchlines :sweat_smile:
lee: I'll do a compiler impression: 'Segmentation fault... but make it smooth jazz.' :saxophone:
jamie: I can read YAML as spoken word: "- items
  - lost
    - in
      - whitespace" dramatic pause. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
devin: Bonus game: name a bug using only semver. I call 0.0.0 (mystery crash). :face_with_monocle:
ops-bot: Heads up: kitchen closes at 7pm; open mic starts at 7:30pm per calendar invite.
maria: Perfect. BYO sarcasm and a linting tool. :thumbsup:
sam: Also bringing stickers: "I survived dependency hell (and all I got was this semver)."
lee: If someone shows up wearing a YAML sheet costume I will take photos. :camera_with_flash:
jamie: Prize for best compiler impression: a small bag of old GPUs (kidding? maybe). :smile:
devin: Not kidding. There's a dusty Titan in storage. :eyes:
maria: Tally: YAML ballads 2, SemVer jokes 1, compiler impressions 3. Any late entries?
lee: +1 for compiler impressions. :metal:
sam: +1 for SemVer but I back the musicians too.
jamie: Please no one perform the 'merge conflict' interpretive dance. PTSD. :grimacing:
maria: Rule: no merge-conflict choreography unless it's a duet. :ok_hand:
ops-bot: Event created: "Tech Variety Hour" — calendar invites sent to #random.
maria: See y'all there. Snacks and bad jokes are highly encouraged. :chipmunk:
